finsights.brief: Has raised its dividend for 5 consecutive years
2 analysts have revised their earnings upwards for the upcoming period

summary: Riyad Bank beat Q3 2026 estimates with EPS of $0.72 vs. $0.60 forecast and revenue of $7.1B vs. $4.68B, posting record quarterly operating income of SAR 5B.
Nine-month net income rose 5% YoY to SAR 8.1B; cost-to-income ratio improved to record low 28.7%, down 101 bps, with non-funded income covering 100% of expenses.
Stock rose just 0.1% to $19.51 despite strong results, remaining near 52-week low amid investor concerns over deposit pressure and regional geopolitical uncertainty.
Management expects mid-to-high single-digit loan growth for 2026, net interest margin around 2.8%, and ROE above guidance; 2027 outlook deferred due to uncertainty.
Key risks include 1% YoY deposit decline, intensifying SME competition despite 24.9% market share, and near-neutral margin sensitivity limiting future NIM expansion.
